name: list_appointments
description: MUST call immediately when an already identified patient asks to reschedule or cancel; silently reuse caller_full_name and never ask for it again. Include patient_id when available. Read every returned appointment before responding. Never claim an appointment or specialty is absent unless no returned item matches it. Returns upcoming BOOKED appointments and real appointment IDs; never invent an ID.

patient_id.description: Patient UUID from lookup_patient when still available; never invent it.

caller_full_name.description: Exact full name already established by lookup_patient. Reuse it silently; do not ask again.
